description: Add imgui config window to VehicleHUD.lua with dark theme, button-based toggles, style/unit selectors, sliders, and /vhud command update
steps: Add showConfigWindow state variable for controlling config window visibility
Add a second imgui.OnFrame for config window rendering with dark theme styling matching PlayerStatsWidget.lua
Implement toggle buttons (not Checkbox) for Enable/Disable using imgui.Button with color push
Implement style selector with 3 buttons (Classic/Digital/Minimal) with active highlight
Implement unit selector with 2 buttons (km/h / mph) with active highlight
Implement Scale slider (0.5 - 2.0) and Opacity slider (0.3 - 1.0)
Implement Reset Position and Reset All buttons
Update /vhud command to toggle config window, add /vhud toggle for quick enable/disable
Set self.HideCursor = false when config window is open
acceptance_criteria: /vhud toggle provides quick enable/disable without opening window
All existing subcommands still work (style, unit, scale, opacity, reset)
Window flags combined with + (not bitwise OR)
Dark theme with WindowRounding 12, FrameRounding 6, WindowPadding 15/12, ItemSpacing 8/6
Config window is a SEPARATE imgui.OnFrame from HUD rendering
HideCursor set to false when config window is open
No pcall inside imgui render functions
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/samp-android-lua-script && luajit -bl VehicleHUD.lua > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?  (should output 0)
Grep for second imgui.OnFrame to verify separate render loop
Grep for showConfigWindow to verify state variable
Verify no imgui.Checkbox usage in the file
findings: All syntax checks pass (luajit -bl returns 0). Config window uses separate imgui.OnFrame. No imgui.Checkbox used - all toggles are Button-based with PushStyleColor for active state highlighting. Pre-allocated imgui.new.float buffers for slider values to avoid per-frame allocation. Window flags combined with + operator. All MonetLoader constraints respected.
